messages:
Erin: FYI RC build 2.3.7 has a hotpatch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/6024 — we need 2x LGTM before 16:00 PT cutoff today. CI is mostly green; one flaky integration test is being investigated. Please ping if you can give final +1.

Jules: I left an approval earlier but flagged the minor logging nit. happy to keep my approve if infra/runtime also ok :+1:

Danny: I'll take a look now, prioritizing this. ETA 10–15m.

Mike: Oncall — I can do a quick smoke after tests. @deploy-bot can you rerun the smoke job in staging?

deploy-bot: Re-run queued for job: `staging-smoke-6024` — started. :gear:

deploy-bot: `staging-smoke-6024` finished — :white_check_mark: all checks passed (4m 12s)

Danny: Reviewed the diff. LGTM. Only comment is optional; not blocking.

Erin: Great — that's 2x LGTM. I'll hold off merge until after the 16:00 cutoff window passes, unless we need an immediate hotfix. @release-coordinator can you merge after the hold window if nothing else crops up?

release-coordinator: Will merge at cutoff+2m. Command I'll run:
```
gh pr merge 6024 --squash --delete-branch
```
Watching for any post-smoke alerts.

Mike: Noted. If we see the integration flake re-appear, revert plan ready.

Erin: Thanks all :rocket:
